radio.title: Slow travel
radio.text: Slow travel is the idea of staying longer in one place instead of visiting many places quickly. Slow travellers often rent a room in a village, learn a few words of the language and buy food at the local market. Supporters say that this is better for the environment and for local people, because money stays in the community. It is also usually cheaper than a fast tour.
